source_manifest.original_slide5_notes: The network contains 355 airport nodes and 6,629 directed routes, representing 3,054,489 flights in the route tables. Its nodes represent 2,821,852 accepted connections, while route counts represent individual flights. The full geographic network remains available in the linked report and Notebook source figure. There, node colour shows supported standardized change, gray indicates no support, and edge width shows flight traffic rather than delay-propagation events. Monthly supported-airport counts are 2026-04: 6, 2026-05: 8, 2026-06: 12, 2026-07: 15, 2026-08: 15. These counts may change under the same frozen reference. Consequently, a range across available airports in one month is not a trend for a fixed airport panel, and the map cannot establish which airport caused a downstream delay.
